name: TC-BF-005 — 产运驳回Brief弹窗与校验 [P0]
description: 验证迭代详情页Brief tab展示及驳回按钮状态（迭代7已过Brief阶段，驳回按钮应不可见）

steps.expression: (() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasBrief = tabs.some(t => t.includes('Brief')); const rejectBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('驳回')); return { tabs, hasBrief, rejectBtnFound: !!rejectBtn }; })()
steps.description: 验证Brief tab存在且驳回按钮状态正确

steps.expression: (() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasBrief = tabs.some(t => t.includes('Brief')); const has打样 = tabs.some(t => t.includes('打样')); const has归档 = tabs.some(t => t.includes('归档')); return { tabs, hasBrief, has打样, has归档, allTabsPresent: hasBrief && has打样 && has归档 }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal?.querySelectorAll('button') || []).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认驳回')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 空表单点确认驳回触发校验

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const errors = Array.from(modal?.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, [class*=error]') || []).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return { stillOpen: !!modal, errors }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为PENDING_BRIEF，当前用户是产运
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击驳回Brief
2. 验证弹窗展示驳回原因(4选项)和详细说明
3. 空表单点确认触发校验
4. 取消弹窗验证不保存
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弹窗展示驳回原因单选（风格定位描述不清、对标店铺不匹配、商品无法拍摄、其他）
2. 详细说明多行文本框必填
3. 未选择/未填写时不允许确认驳回
4. 取消不保存驳回信息
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
